key_insight: The paper formalizes quantum neural network design in Lean 4, giving certified results that connect expressivity, trainability, and structural guarantees through proof-checked theorems.
engineering_relevance: It provides a machine-checkable foundation for choosing QNN architectures with provable expressivity and trainability properties, supporting safer AI-assisted quantum model design.
method: Formalized QNN theory in Lean 4 with every analytic assumption either proved or named as a hypothesis.
Proved exact single-qubit characterization, a resource-counted quantum phase processing theorem, and a QFI-rank ceiling tied to DLA dimension.
Derived a direct-sum loss-variance law and a capstone result linking conditional variance to exact loss reconstruction in DLA coordinates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-kernel-checked development that identified eight corrections and clarifications beyond the informal arguments.
watch_item: The strongest guarantees depend on explicit hypotheses and family-specific assumptions, so applying them to new QNN architectures may require additional formalization and proof work.
paper_title: An Agentic Formalization for Certified Quantum Neural Network Design
